label: Dell OptiPlex 7010 Micro
description: 1.2-litre micro desktop with 13th-gen Core T-series, external 90W adapter and a single 1GbE RJ45.
notes: 1GbE RJ45 (Intel I219-LM) on the rear of a 1.2 L chassis; wired-only by default - Wi-Fi 6E is an optional M.2 card. Compact desktop node for dense lab topologies.
